author: David Fortier
title: DeWitt Page Park Road closure impacts Page Park access this week - NewsBreak
text:
By David Fortier ,
1 days ago A portion of Dewitt Page Park Road closed earlier today, May 26, limiting access by car and foot, Bristol Parks, Recreation, Youth and Community Services announced. The road closure will be broken into two phases. The first phase of road closures, beginning today, will see DeWitt Page Park Road closed from just beyond the lower parking lot entrances to just before the upper parking lot (overlooking the tennis courts). Parking lot access will not be impacted but community members will not be able to access the upper parking lot from the King Street entrance. Community members looking to access the upper parking lot can use the park entrances located on Moody Street and/or Woodland Street. Read full article
